definitions.gloss: Tokushima; prefecture and city in Shikoku
definitions.explanation: A prefecture in the east of {四国|しこく}, and its capital city. It is best known for the {阿波踊|あわおど}り dance festival in August, the whirlpools of {鳴門|なると}, and its long history of indigo dyeing.

examples.japanese: {徳島|とくしま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{四国|しこく}→四国：21447_shikoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{徳島|とくしま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{阿波踊|あわおど}り→阿波踊り：31052_awaodori⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I watched the Awa Odori dance in Tokushima in the summer.

examples.japanese: {徳島|とくしま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{昔|むかし}→昔：01515_mukashi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{藍染|あいぞ}め→藍染め：23047_aizome⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧で、「{阿波|あわ}⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧」⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: Tokushima has long been a center of indigo dyeing, known as Awa indigo.

notes:
USAGE:
- {徳島|とくしま} names both the city and the prefecture; {徳島県|とくしまけん} and {徳島市|とくしまし} make it explicit.

RELATED WORDS:
- {阿波|あわ}: the old province name, still used in ⟦{阿波踊|あわおど}り→阿波踊り：31052_awaodori⟧ and {阿波|あわ}⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧
- {鳴門|なると}: the city known for its whirlpools in the strait to Awaji Island
